title: tt-xla discovery — go/no-go for P3b Track 2

compatibility_notes.python_version_mismatch: p3a-ngram container uses Python 3.10; tt-xla wheel is cp312 only. Requires separate container (tt-xla-slim:latest).
compatibility_notes.torch_version_mismatch: p3a-ngram has torch 2.7.1; tt-xla needs torch 2.9.1+cpu. Cannot coexist in same venv.
compatibility_notes.ttnn_vs_pjrt: tt-xla bundles its own tt-metal runtime via PJRT plugin. Does NOT use ttnn directly.

basic_matmul.notes: JIT compiled 33 kernels, ~690ms each on first run

mnist_cnn.notes: Official example, CNN + Conv2D + maxpool, bfloat16

gpt2_naive.notes: Naive model.to(xla_device) produces inf logits. This is NOT the supported usage pattern.

tinyllama_1.1b_generation.output: The capital of France is Paris.
tinyllama_1.1b_generation.compilation_overhead: ~9s per new shape (2 shapes: prefill + decode)
tinyllama_1.1b_generation.notes: Correct output. Must use torch.compile(backend='tt') with StaticCache and explicit cache_position management.

architecture_findings.usage_pattern: torch.compile(backend='tt') is REQUIRED. Naive model.to(xla_device) produces garbage.
architecture_findings.static_cache: transformers.cache_utils.StaticCache is required for generation loops. DynamicCache triggers recompilation.
architecture_findings.spmd: SPMD mode (xr.use_spmd()) enables multi-device tensor parallelism. Required for 2-device setups.
architecture_findings.compilation: First invocation per unique shape triggers JIT compilation (~9s for TinyLlama). Subsequent calls with same shape are cached (<0.01s).
architecture_findings.sharding: Model weights and KV cache can be sharded across devices via torch_xla.distributed.spmd.mark_sharding().
architecture_findings.sglang_integration_challenge: SGLang's ModelRunner uses model(input_ids, positions, forward_batch) signature. tt-xla needs torch.compile + StaticCache + cache_position. Bridge layer needed.

next_steps: Task 2.3: Create TenstorrentXLAGenericCausalLM with torch.compile(backend='tt') + StaticCache
Task 2.4: Register tt-xla models in registry.py
